def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    hdiv=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=bg]
    vdiv=[c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and grid[0][c]!=bg]
    if not hdiv: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    hc=grid[hdiv[0]][0]
    hs=[r for r in hdiv if grid[r][0]==hc]
    vs=[c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==hc for r in range(h) if r not in hs)]
    if not vs: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    rb=[-1]+hs+[h]; cb=[-1]+vs+[w]
    bands=[(rb[i]+1,rb[i+1]) for i in range(len(rb)-1)]
    panels=[(cb[i]+1,cb[i+1]) for i in range(len(cb)-1)]
    src=max(((ri,ci) for ri in range(len(bands)) for ci in range(len(panels))),
            key=lambda z:sum(v!=bg and v not in (hc,hc) for row in grid[bands[z[0]][0]:bands[z[0]][1]] for v in row[panels[z[1]][0]:panels[z[1]][1]]))
    (ra,rz),(ca,cz)=bands[src[0]],panels[src[1]]
    motif=[row[ca:cz] for row in grid[ra:rz]]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for a,b in bands:
        for x,y in panels:
            if (a,b)==bands[src[0]] and (x,y)==panels[src[1]]: continue
            for r in range(a,b):
                for c in range(x,y): out[r][c]=motif[(r-a)%len(motif)][(c-x)%len(motif[0])]
    return out

def transform(grid):
    # Repeating pattern: full-width horizontal separators and full-height vertical separator
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    hsep = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != 0]
    if not hsep:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    sep_color = grid[hsep[0]][0]
    v_candidates = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep_color for r in range(h))]
    if not v_candidates:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    v = v_candidates[0]
    # The nonempty tile is the block between the last two horizontal separators;
    # extend it periodically to fill all tiles in the pattern.
    bands=[]
    edges=[-1]+hsep+[h]
    for a,b in zip(edges,edges[1:]): bands.append((a+1,b))
    cols=[(0,v),(v+1,w)]
    # pick tile with most non-background cells, excluding separator rows/column
    candidates=[]
    for a,b in bands:
      for x,y in cols:
        n=sum(cell not in (0,sep_color) for row in grid[a:b] for cell in row[x:y])
        if n: candidates.append((n,a,b,x,y))
    if not candidates: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    _,a,b,x,y=max(candidates)
    tile=[row[x:y] for row in grid[a:b]]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for aa,bb in bands:
      for xx,yy in cols:
        if (aa,bb,xx,yy)==(a,b,x,y): continue
        for r in range(aa,bb):
          for c in range(xx,yy):
            out[r][c]=tile[(r-aa)%len(tile)][(c-xx)%len(tile[0])]
    return out

def transform(grid):
    # Identify repeated horizontal dividers and a vertical divider, then tile the
    # nonzero source panel across the resulting panel layout.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    hsep = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != bg]
    if not hsep:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    sep = grid[hsep[0]][0]
    vcols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    if not vcols:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    v = vcols[0]
    edges = [-1] + hsep + [h]
    bands = [(a+1,b) for a,b in zip(edges,edges[1:])]
    panels = [(0,v),(v+1,w)]
    candidates=[]
    for a,b in bands:
        for x,y in panels:
            score=sum(z != bg and z != sep for row in grid[a:b] for z in row[x:y])
            if score: candidates.append((score,a,b,x,y))
    if not candidates: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    _,a,b,x,y=max(candidates)
    tile=[row[x:y] for row in grid[a:b]]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for aa,bb in bands:
        for xx,yy in panels:
            for r in range(aa,bb):
                for c in range(xx,yy):
                    out[r][c]=tile[(r-aa)%len(tile)][(c-xx)%len(tile[0])]
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Solid non-background rows/columns are panel separators.
    hsep = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    if not hsep:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    sep = grid[hsep[0]][0]
    v_candidates = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    vs = v_candidates[:1]
    row_bounds = [-1] + hsep + [h]
    bands = [(a+1,b) for a,b in zip(row_bounds,row_bounds[1:]) if a+1 < b]
    col_bounds = [-1] + vs + [w]
    panels = [(a+1,b) for a,b in zip(col_bounds,col_bounds[1:]) if a+1 < b]
    # Pick the panel with the most non-background content as the repeating motif.
    best = None
    for ri,(a,b) in enumerate(bands):
        for ci,(x,y) in enumerate(panels):
            score = sum(v != bg and v != sep for row in grid[a:b] for v in row[x:y])
            if best is None or score > best[0]: best=(score,ri,ci)
    if best is None or best[0] == 0: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    _,sr,sc=best
    a,b=bands[sr]; x,y=panels[sc]
    tile=[row[x:y] for row in grid[a:b]]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for ri,(aa,bb) in enumerate(bands):
        for ci,(xx,yy) in enumerate(panels):
            if ri==sr and ci==sc: continue
            for r in range(aa,bb):
                for c in range(xx,yy): out[r][c]=tile[(r-aa)%len(tile)][(c-xx)%len(tile[0])]
    return out
PY

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Repeat the non-separator tile below the solid separator into the empty
    # rows above it, preserving the separator and source tile.
    sep = next((r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1), None)
    if sep is None or sep + 1 >= h:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    tile = [row[:] for row in grid[sep+1:]]
    if not any(v != grid[0][0] for row in tile for v in row):
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(sep):
        out[r] = tile[r % len(tile)][:]
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # The horizontal line color serves as the delimiter; the object pattern
    # from the row directly beneath it repeats upward through the blank rows.
    sep=next((r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))==1 and r>0),None)
    if sep is None:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    tile=grid[sep+1:]
    if not tile:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(sep):
        out[r]=tile[(r-sep)%len(tile)][:]
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # A solid non-background row separates repeated horizontal panels. The
    # nonempty panel below it is the source tile, repeated into rows above.
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    separators = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                  if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    if not separators:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    sep = separators[-1]
    tile = [row[:] for row in grid[sep + 1:]]
    if not tile:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(sep):
        out[r] = tile[(r - sep - 1) % len(tile)][:]
    return out
